# Geergit v2.6 RC2 (20600) — Release Notes  

## 1. Device Emulator Configs Support  
- Added support for importing **Device Emulator config files** (`.den`).  

## 2. vbmeta Hash Handling  
- Temporarily **removed vbmeta hash support** (will be reintroduced later with a dedicated toggle).  

## 3. Compatibility  
- Geergit can now be installed on **Android 9 and below**.  

## 4. New Features  
- **Folder Management**: Organize profiles/projects into folders for better efficiency.  
- **Profile Rename**: Easily rename existing profiles.  
- **Advanced Anti-Fingerprinting**: Added new options to enhance privacy and device spoofing.  

## 5. Improvements & Fixes  
- Fixed **WiFi BSSID bug**.  
- Profile list now shows the **first two lines of notes**.  
- Various **performance optimizations and bug fixes** for smoother operation.

# Geergit v2.9.5

## New Features
- Added option to **exclude specific apps from backup** within a Group.
- New profile creation options:
  - **Clear Data Only** (no backup taken).
  - **Force Stop Only** (no clear data, no backup).
    - Useful for setups involving **GMS (Google Mobile Services)**.

## Bug Fixes
1. Fixed **backup restore error** (`Map is not a subtype of Iterable`).
2. Fixed **group data mixing issue**.
3. Fixed **unable to add victim apps to groups (gray screen)**.
4. Fixed issues during **profile switching**.
5. Fixed **victim apps getting auto-removed**.
6. Fixed **excessive storage usage** caused by Geergit.
7. Fixed **group deletion not working**.
8. Fixed issue where **selecting one profile selected multiple profiles**.

## Improvements
- General stability and performance improvements.

changelog.name: v2.9.4 - Quality of Life
changelog.body:
# Geergit v2.9.4 (20904)

## Improvements & Fixes
1. Added ability to **restore profiles from backups already present on the device**.
2. Fixed **individual app backup restore bug**.
3. Backup `.tar` files now contain **valid profile detail values**.
4. Fixed **backup not working issue**.
   - If backup is still not working, try:
     - Clear Geergit app data.
     - Open the app again and retry.
5. General improvements and bug fixes.

---

# How to Import Profiles from Another Account

1. Export profiles from the **primary device**.
2. Send the backup file to the **secondary device**.
3. Go to **Group or App → Gear Icon (⚙️) → Import Profile**.
4. Go to **Gear Icon (⚙️) → Restore Backups** → wait → select the profiles you want to restore.
5. Go back to **Import Profile**:
   - Click the **Refresh button** beside the search bar.
   - Verify the missing profiles are restored.

---

# How to Restore Profiles Missing After Updating

1. Go to the **Group or App** where profiles are missing.
2. Tap **Gear Icon (⚙️) → Restore Backups** → wait → select the profiles to restore.
3. Go to **Import Profile**:
   - Click the **Refresh button** beside the search bar.
   - Confirm the profiles are restored.

changelog.name: v2.9.3 - Location and Quality of Life
changelog.body:
# Geergit v2.9.3 — Location & Quality of Life Update

## Location Spoofing
- Added per-app location spoofing.
- Timezone is not yet spoofed with location (planned for a future update).

## UI & UX Improvements
- Compact UI mode for viewing a large number of profiles at once.
- Group Page is now the default screen when Geergit is opened.
- Removed folder name display next to profiles for a cleaner UI.
- Geergit now remembers the last selected folder.
- Support dropped for Android 9 and below.

## Profile & Group Management
- Removed minimum 3-character search restriction.
- Move profiles:
  - From Group A → Group B
  - From Individual App → Group

## Backup & Restore (Major Rewrite)
- Improved backup and restore behavior:
  - App permissions are now preserved after restoring profiles.
  - New backups are created as `.tar` archives instead of folders (reduces storage usage).
- Backup & import flow optimized to support Android 10 → Android 16+.
- Added 3 new options in *Backup App Data* feature.

## Advanced Backup Options
- Undetectable Mode:
  - Use if the target app crashes after backup.
  - Takes 1–3 minutes per app.
  - Prevents detection and post-restore crashes.
- Preserve Permissions toggle added when switching profiles.
- Clear Cache on Import option added:
  - Improves restore speed.
  - Can be disabled if the app relies on cache for performance.

## Stability Fixes
- Fixed an issue where Geergit could cause device restarts or complete system hangs on some devices.

## Internal Changes & Notes
- Backup & import system rewritten from scratch:
  - Designed for modern Android versions.
  - Prevents detection during profile switching.
- General bug fixes and improvements.

### ⚠ Important Note
- If Google Play Services is added directly to Geergit, Geergit will crash.
- To avoid this:
  - Add Google Play Services to LSPosed.
